---
title: "Data Catalog"
description: "What data exists, where it came from, and how it may be used."
toc: true
---

The project uses three kinds of data. This catalog separates data supplied by
the organizers from evidence we collected or generated. Sensitive response text
is never reproduced in this static site.

::: {.hub-data-groups}
## Organizer-provided data

These records define the development task and how its rankings are evaluated.

::: {.hub-data-grid}
::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Candidate inventory](candidate-inventory.qmd)

The identifiers of the 150 LLMs that each request must rank.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Provided</span><span class="hub-badge hub-available">Tracked and complete</span></div>
:::

::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Development queries](dev-queries.qmd)

Historical user requests used to develop and compare ranking methods.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Provided</span><span class="hub-badge hub-available">Tracked and complete</span></div>
:::

::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Development relevance judgments](dev-qrels.qmd)

Organizer labels indicating which candidate models suited each development
request. These evaluate a ranking; they are not descriptions of the candidates.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Provided</span><span class="hub-badge hub-available">Tracked and complete</span></div>
:::
:::

## Collected evidence

Evidence gathered from candidate models under bounded project protocols.

::: {.hub-data-grid}
::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Discovery responses](discovery-responses.qmd)

Collected model responses used as candidate-side evidence in bounded studies.
The metadata is tracked, while raw content may remain local-only.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Collected</span><span class="hub-badge hub-restricted">Metadata only</span></div>
:::
:::

## Generated data and run evidence

Artifacts produced by our ranking and evaluation workflows.

::: {.hub-data-grid}
::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Generated embeddings and profiles](generated-embeddings.qmd)

Machine-generated vectors and summaries used to compare requests or describe
candidates. Availability varies by study.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Generated</span><span class="hub-badge hub-mixed">Mixed availability</span></div>
:::

::: {.hub-data-card}
### [Run evidence artifacts](run-artifacts.qmd)

Rankings, metrics, per-query tables, and receipts supporting technical runs.
The ledger records which artifacts are complete, receipt-only, or missing.

<div class="hub-badges"><span class="hub-badge">Generated</span><span class="hub-badge hub-mixed">Mixed by run</span></div>
:::
:::
:::
